payload.evidence: To submit U16 on main 7396689e, the formal gate reported a missing build-impact.json for the new project_brief editor plugin. The six native operation checks had already passed on editor 3bb04068. The original package round trip proved an editable field, a read-only update and restoration on one editor, but did not exercise an incompatible plugin loader.
payload.diagnosis: The new Godot addon is loaded as a replaceable project runtime package. The candidate omitted its module-boundary record and a dedicated incompatible-addon check.
payload.next_action: Bind the current plugin files and measured same-editor update and rollback, test rejection of a valid GDScript with an incompatible EditorPlugin base, then repeat the original complete gate and verify the signed main delivery.
